en: Doraemon: Nobita's Chronicle of the Moon Exploration
plotEn:
One morning, Nobita learns about the mysterious happenings on the Moon and tells his classmates that it was the Moon Rabbits, but nobody believes him. He tries to prove it by imitating the rabbits making rice cakes, but ends up hitting his teacher in the face and is punished to go stand outside the classroom in the school hallway, where Nobita cries out Doraemon's name. When Nobita returns home, he tells Doraemon about what had happened at school, to which Doraemon reluctantly pulls out the "Divergent View Badge" gadget and creates an atmosphere on the Moon. Using the animal clay, they create Moonbit rabbits and return home. Later, Nobita's mother tells him to bring Susuki grass for the Moon Viewing Ceremony, where he ends up seeing a boy and calls out for him, but the boy ends up suddenly disappearing. The next day, a new student named Luca arrives, and Nobita is surprised that it is the same boy he had seen yesterday.
When Nobita is home again, he asks Doraemon to take him back to the Kingdom. Upon reaching there, they find the bamboo plants glowing, which was the effect of the "Shining Moss" they had spread earlier. Nobita heads to the playground to see his close friends Shizuka, Gian, and Suneo, where he gives them each a badge and invites them to go with him to the Kingdom. Luca comes by and joins them, and Nobita gives them all a grand welcome to the rabbit kingdom. They meet a rabbit resembling Nobita and named it Nobit, teasing Nobita.
